abstract: The present study was undertaken to test the parallel detectability of ovarian cancer antigen CA 125 and gastrointestinal cancer antigen CA 19-9 in the sera of patients with malignant ovarian tumors, benign ovarian tumors, endometrial cancers, cervical cancers, colorectal cancers, and trophoblastic tumors and in early 1st-trimester pregnant as well as in healthy nonpregnant controls. In all kinds of gynecologic and colorectal tumors raised concentrations of both antigens were found with the exception of malignant nonepithelial ovarian tumors where neither of the antigens showed positive reaction. The most positive cases were found in the group with epithelial ovarian cancers. Of the two antigens CA 125 was the more responsive. No positive cases were found with either of the antigens in nonpregnant healthy controls or in patients with benign ovarian tumors. The parallel determination of the two antigens gives us a better opportunity to recognize pelvic tumors and further may enable us to distinguish ovarian and colorectal tumors.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、悪性および良性の卵巣腫瘍、子宮体癌および子宮頸癌、大腸癌、絨毛性腫瘍の患者、および早期の妊娠初期の妊婦と非妊娠の健常対照における、卵巣癌抗原CA 125と消化器癌抗原CA 19-9の血清中検出性を並行して検討したものである。非上皮性の悪性卵巣腫瘍を除くすべての婦人科腫瘍および大腸腫瘍で、両抗原の濃度上昇が認められた。最も陽性率が高かったのは上皮性卵巣癌の群であった。2つの抗原のうちCA 125のほうが反応性が高かった。非妊娠の健常対照および良性卵巣腫瘍の患者では、いずれの抗原も陽性例は認められなかった。両抗原を並行して測定することで、骨盤内腫瘍をより良く認識でき、さらに卵巣腫瘍と大腸腫瘍を鑑別できる可能性がある。
